name: NanoOWL -> NanoSAM joint VLM perception pipeline
process_model: single process, in-process reuse of NanoOWL OwlPredictor and NanoSAM Predictor; no subprocess of the two CLIs; no third_party modification

required_or_defaulted_args.--image: path to input image (default: NanoOWL sample asset)
required_or_defaulted_args.--score-threshold: NanoOWL detection score threshold, default 0.10 (matches E2 primary reporting threshold)
required_or_defaulted_args.--top-k: max NanoOWL detections (desc by score) pushed through NanoSAM; default 1; -1 = all above threshold
required_or_defaulted_args.--target-label: optional: restrict detections to this label before applying top-k
required_or_defaulted_args.--nanoowl-engine: TensorRT image encoder engine path (default: frozen E1/E2 owlvit_image_encoder_patch32.engine)

output_contract.detections.json: full structured result: input/text/threshold/top_k, all NanoOWL detections, selected top-k detections, per-detection bridge + NanoSAM result, status in {OK, NO_DETECTION}
output_contract.overlay.jpg: single image with all selected top-k boxes + masks drawn (one color per detection)
output_contract.mask.png: binary mask (0/255) for the rank-1 (highest score) selected detection; additional detections (top-k>1) saved as mask_k2.png, mask_k3.png, ...

excluded_defaults: third_party/nanosam/data/resnet18_image_encoder.engine (untrained upstream default -- WRONG, was the pre-E4 bug, now only reachable via explicit --nanosam-image-encoder-engine override)
models/self_distilled/epoch50/int8/nanosam_resnet18_epoch049_int8.engine (INT8 research backend, quality-gate FAIL, -2.15% mIoU vs FP16)

mask_selection_rule: fixed slot 0 (hi_res_mask[0,0] > 0), NOT IoU argmax -- same convention as scripts/run_nanosam_infer.py and eval_nanosam_coco.py

top_k_policy.rationale: matches the common single-object 'find the X' robotics use case; NanoSAM image embedding (set_image) computed once per input image and reused across all top-k detections to avoid redundant vision-encoder calls
top_k_policy.no_detection_path: if 0 detections survive --score-threshold (and optional --target-label filter), pipeline exits cleanly with status=NO_DETECTION and does NOT call NanoSAM
